configuration.enablement: Selected by default. `MD` selects this rule and `MD001` selects only it. `lint.ignore = ["MD001"]`, a matching `lint.per-file-ignores` entry, or removing `builtin` from `plugins` removes the rule from the enabled set before it runs. A `stilyagi: disable MD001` directive instead suppresses reported findings after evaluation, so a suppressed heading remains the depth the next heading compares against.

rule.explanation: The first heading may use any depth. A later heading may descend by any amount but may not increase by more than one level at a time, because a skipped level makes the document outline ambiguous for readers and assistive technology. The diagnostic covers the whole heading node, marker included.
rule.fixes: The rule reports a manual suggestion. The correct heading level is a prose decision, so no edit is applied automatically and neither `--fix` nor `--unsafe-fixes` changes the heading.
limitations: Only headings with a locatable node span are reported; a heading the extractor cannot map to source bytes is skipped.
The rule compares depth only: it does not enforce a document outline or a maximum depth, and a document may begin at any level.
Configuration, per-file ignores, and suppression directives can stop a finding; static metadata does not describe effective enablement for a particular file.
rule.name: heading-depth
rule.summary: Report heading depth jumps greater than one.
